System Requirements Function Description

Front-end Function
1: User Login: Freshmen log in through the WeChat applet. Each user needs to record the student number, student name, student gender, student class, student branch, and student dormitory.
2: View school information: Freshmen can view the school's introduction, facilities and other information. The school needs to record the school number, school name, school introduction, and school facilities.
3: View branch information: Freshmen can view the detailed information of their branch. The branch needs to record the branch number, branch name, and branch introduction.
4: View class information: Freshmen can view their own class information. The class needs to record the class number, class name, and class introduction.
5: View teacher information: Freshmen can view the detailed information of the class teacher. The teacher needs to record the teacher number, teacher name, teacher title, and teacher profile.
6: View course information: Freshmen can view the course information of their own class. The course needs to record the course number, course name, course description, and course credits.
7: View dormitory arrangement information: Freshmen can view their own dormitory allocation. Dormitory information includes dormitory number, dormitory building, dormitory room number, and number of dormitory beds.
8: View the course schedule: New students can view their own course schedule.

Background functions
1: Add school information: Administrators can add or modify the basic information of the school.
2: Add branch information: Administrators can add or modify branch information.
3: Add class information: Administrators can add or modify class information.
4: Add teacher information: Administrators can add or modify teacher information.
5: Add course information: Administrators can add or modify course information.
6: Add student information: Administrators can add or modify student information.
7: Add dormitory information: Administrators can add or modify dormitory information.
8: Add course schedule information: Administrators can add or modify course schedule information.

--Schemafordatabase:rschema_0157
--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `students` (
  `student_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `student_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `student_gender` char(6) NOT NULL,
  `student_class` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `student_branch` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `student_dormitory` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_number`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`student_class`) REFERENCES `classes` (`class_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`student_branch`) REFERENCES `branches` (`branch_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`student_dormitory`) REFERENCES `dormitories` (`dormitory_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `schools` (
  `school_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `school_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `school_introduction` text NOT NULL,
  `school_facilities` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`school_number`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `branches` (
  `branch_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `branch_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `branch_introduction` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`branch_number`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `classes` (
  `class_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `class_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `class_introduction` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`class_number`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `teachers` (
  `teacher_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `teacher_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `teacher_title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `teacher_profile` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`teacher_number`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `courses` (
  `course_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `course_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `course_description` text NOT NULL,
  `course_credits` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`course_number`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `dormitories` (
  `dormitory_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `dormitory_building` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `dormitory_room_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `number_of_dormitory_beds` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`dormitory_number`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `course_schedules` (
  `course_schedule_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `course_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `class_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `teacher_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `start_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `end_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`course_schedule_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`course_number`) REFERENCES `courses` (`course_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`class_number`) REFERENCES `classes` (`class_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`teacher_number`) REFERENCES `teachers` (`teacher_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
